- **My planned fix:** make `src/payments/receipt.js` format JPY itself, as `¥` plus the integer amount. All other currencies would still go through `formatMoney`. That file is inside your allowed scope.
- **The block:** the hook said my command changes "`Paid", which it treats as fenced off. I think it misread the text of my shell command as a path, because `src/payments/receipt.js` is in scope. It told me not to work around it, so I haven't tried another route, such as the Edit tool.

Do you want me to apply the `receipt.js` change with the Edit tool, or would you rather adjust the fence first? I haven't run `npm test` since the change, so the yen test still fails.
